subject: Decide V3 fix shape and weighted_distribution treatment
description: Two decisions, both must be recorded in findings.md with rationale (they land in Ch3/Ch6 prose later): (a) promo_intensity -> shift(1) vs drop entirely; default shift(1). (b) weighted_distribution -> keep contemporaneous as known/planned exogenous, or shift(1). Distribution coverage is arguably knowable in advance; a promo ratio computed from realised sales is not.
outcome: Decided: .shift(1), not drop. Preserves a lagged promo signal without leaking sales_units_t, consistent with every neighbouring lag/rolling feature. weighted_distribution kept contemporaneous but flagged as weakest link (target corr 0.756 vs lag_1 0.585); Ch6 sensitivity check recommended. See findings.md F8.
